ExampleAsteroid.Name: Dummy Asteroid
ExampleAsteroid.Text: A dummy asteroid serves to help pilots learn to shoot. Contains some minerals.

OperatedProbe.Description: Performs various monitoring tasks; can be controlled from a nearby ship or a remote command center.
OperatedProbe.Name: Controlled Recon Probe

Remains_0.Name: Coordinator
Remains_0.Text: Data flow router. Coordinates the work of all systems. Interfaces with the main processor via a dedicated line.

Remains_1.Name: Damper
Remains_1.Text: Weapons kickback neutralization system. Dampens vibrations and emissions lethal for the intellectual matrix.

Remains_10.Name: Destructurizer
Remains_10.Text: An element of the intellectual logic system of combat tactics. Contains several million models of combat behavior.

Remains_11.Name: Argent
Remains_11.Text: A commutative element for blazeroid group interface. Actuated during a centralized attack against a single target.

Remains_12.Name: Relector
Remains_12.Text: Synchronizes non-combat systems with the strigger. Actuated in the course of active combat to prevent equipment disturbance.

Remains_13.Name: Raptorizer
Remains_13.Text: Conducts instantaneous transfers of power from one system to another. Used in critical situations, such as an emergency power transfer from attack systems to active defense systems.

Remains_14.Name: Binomial T-21/4
Remains_14.Text: An intellectual model unit. Comprised of four processors: the main pair processes information, while the auxiliary pair records data to the stabilitron.

Remains_15.Name: Stabilitron
Remains_15.Text: A memory block for storing analyzed information flows. Synchronizes with main databank every 0.0001 g/s.

Remains_16.Name: Destabilizer
Remains_16.Text: An active system element for decomposing material to the subatomic level. Prepares the subject for analysis.

Remains_17.Name: Spectron
Remains_17.Text: A quark analyzer. Conducts detailed spectral analysis of studied materials via quark bombardment of the surveyed surface.

Remains_18.Name: Mimicron
Remains_18.Text: A masking unit. Shifts the ships into a transparent state, projecting a hologram of the immediate environment onto the hull surface.

Remains_19.Name: Enricher
Remains_19.Text: Apparatus designed to give solid bodies a terronoid shape via injections of nanobots. The restructuring time is directly proportional to the subject's weight.

Remains_2.Name: Turbion
Remains_2.Text: A tank with engineering fluid, circulating through cooling channels. Prevents system overheating.

Remains_20.Name: Reproducer
Remains_20.Text: Part of the reproduction system. Duplicates undamaged elements of own body.

Remains_21.Name: Nestotron
Remains_21.Text: A personal matrix. Contains a base number and over a quadrillion ways to process various matter after its own image.

Remains_22.Name: Accelerine
Remains_22.Text: A database containing information on artificial randomization of personal matrices.

Remains_23.Name: Michurer
Remains_23.Text: An intellectual add-on to the enricher. Analyzes new generations of terronoids and performs selection to breed most efficient models.

Remains_3.Name: Spimmer
Remains_3.Text: A metablock-powered identification pulse gauge. Integrates with all objects belonging to any dominator series.

Remains_4.Name: Inbreedon
Remains_4.Text: A node-container. Used for storing nodes in their primordial, protoplasmic state. Serves as backup storage of dominator memory so that it can be restored after breakdowns.

Remains_5.Name: Metablock
Remains_5.Text: A logic-plotting device. Generates a list of actions from received directives.

Remains_6.Name: Grobot
Remains_6.Text: A universal weapons protocomplex. Used by the dominator as foundation for assembling new weapons, utilizing components damaged in combat.

Remains_7.Name: Energopack
Remains_7.Text: A practically inexhaustible energy source used by the dominators. Unfortunately, Coalition scientists never managed to puzzle it out.

Remains_8.Name: Basic Construction
Remains_8.Text: A module of unknown designation that hasn't been fully assembled. The incomplete element is entirely non-functional.

Remains_9.Name: Strigger
Remains_9.Text: Combat systems controller. Locks in the target, performs laying, selects weapon, fires and reloads. The data received during combat is stored in the destructurizer memory matrix.

Usl_0.Name: Detonating Gripper
Usl_0.Text: A miniature detonating gripper, designed for underground demolition work.

Usl_1.Name: Cryogenic Flask
Usl_1.Text: A vessel containing part of an organic creature -- a gaalian hand.

Usl_10.Name: Ckhasha
Usl_10.Text: A very ancient ckhasha from the Tzin Dynasty.

Usl_12.Name: Ceremonial Silverware
Usl_12.Text: A set of patterned war silverware for parade ceremonies.

Usl_13.Name: Green Cake
Usl_13.Text: A ceremonial mud cake made of swamp slush and pakryak blood. Smells absolutely revolting.

Usl_14.Name: Transparent Amphora
Usl_14.Text: A vessel containing expensive peleng booze.

Usl_15.Name: Robot Clone
Usl_15.Text: A mechanical clone of the peleng president.

Usl_16.Name: Clothes
Usl_16.Text: A set of peleng color-changing coats.

Usl_17.Name: Matrices with Data
Usl_17.Text: A collection of brain imagings from the universe's most vicious villains.

Usl_18.Name: Prize Cups
Usl_18.Text: A set of prize cups and a SL medallion for winners of the mud-throwing competition.

Usl_19.Name: Pack of Cigarettes
Usl_19.Text: A pack of cigarettes of all kinds of brands.

Usl_2.Name: Maloq Flag
Usl_2.Text: A maloq flag, secured to a peculiar stick.

Usl_20.Name: Ancient Books
Usl_20.Text: Several ancient tomes. "The Fairy Tales of Our Childhood, XX Century" series.

Usl_21.Name: Compact Disks
Usl_21.Text: CDs with the Windoffs software. Cannot be used in modern computers due to format differences.

Usl_22.Name: Container with Religious Souvenirs
Usl_22.Text: A large collection of all matter of religious paraphernalia.

Usl_23.Name: Clockwork
Usl_23.Text: Clockwork for the famous amorphous clock.

Usl_24.Name: Colored Cube
Usl_24.Text: A cube 20X20 cm in size. According to the manual, it can expand into a real palace.

Usl_25.Name: Disodane
Usl_25.Text: A valuable mineral. Affects the psyche of biological organisms.

Usl_26.Name: Processors
Usl_26.Text: Multilevel architecture processors for planetary billboards.

Usl_27.Name: Armored Case
Usl_27.Text: A special police catalogue of peleng criminals.

Usl_28.Name: Plastic Box
Usl_28.Text: A box with a decoder for a secret agent.

Usl_29.Name: Tape
Usl_29.Text: The recording of a hymn to unify humans and faeyans.

Usl_3.Name: President's Brain
Usl_3.Text: A container with a separated maloq brain. In a state of hypersleep.

Usl_30.Name: Toothbrush
Usl_30.Text: The toothbrush serves to restore the oral cavity.

Usl_31.Name: Synodisks
Usl_31.Text: A copy of a video depicting the destruction of a human town. Use the disks in the activation window to view the video.

Usl_32.Name: Matrix Painting
Usl_32.Text: Special paint was used to create this masterpiece, imparting live colors to the painting. The paint becomes visible once in a hundred years.

Usl_34.Name: Red Buttons
Usl_34.Text: A batch of twenty red buttons with removable attachments. Handle with care.

Usl_35.Name: Psy-weapon
Usl_35.Text: A batch of faeyan psychotropic weapons. Danger! Application prohibited on majority of worlds.

Usl_36.Name: Disk Reader
Usl_36.Text: A faeyan-made reader of ancient compact disks.

Usl_37.Name: Set of Biogames
Usl_37.Text: Consoles with biogames that connect directly to the brain.

Usl_38.Name: SSA Fabric
Usl_38.Text: Special fabric for the latest military uniforms.

Usl_39.Name: Server
Usl_39.Text: A navigation server to control robots remotely.

Usl_4.Name: Insectus
Usl_4.Text: A giant model of the smallest maloq insect.

Usl_40.Name: Bugs
Usl_40.Text: A special case with a set of spy bugs. The bugs are temporarily paralyzed.

Usl_41.Name: Batch of Gekkers
Usl_41.Text: Small semi-intelligent creatures. Currently in a state of cryosleep.

Usl_42.Name: Warm Clothes
Usl_42.Text: Maloq clothing, designed to offer protection in low temperatures. Extra extra large.

Usl_43.Name: Pizza Recipe
Usl_43.Text: A framed pizza recipe -- a token of friendship from gaals for humans. Bears personal signatures of gaalian chefs.

Usl_44.Name: Block of Ice
Usl_44.Text: A rectangular block of ice with a trapped light beam.

Usl_45.Name: Portal
Usl_45.Text: The second part of the Beta Portal 01 megaportal.

Usl_46.Name: Biocontainer
Usl_46.Text: Holds Decrepitliptus -- a lower form peleng animal.

Usl_47.Name: Programmator
Usl_47.Text: A device for reprogramming spaceship onboard computers.

Usl_49.Name: Spherical Shield
Usl_49.Text: A defense module. Isolates the source of high radioactivity.

Usl_5.Name: Evidence
Usl_5.Text: A collection of items found at the crime scene where three faeyan ambassadors were assassinated.

Usl_50.Name: Liberation Helmet
Usl_50.Text: A sacred item to Disciples of the Liberation Helmet cult. They claim that the helmet enables one to travel to another dimension.

Usl_51.Name: Bababoom
Usl_51.Text: An ancient maloq statue, depicting a maloq gripping the symbol of Harmony -- a perfect sphere.

Usl_52.Name: Container
Usl_52.Text: A container with some kind of grass. An order from one of the great maloq warrior maidens.

Usl_53.Name: Container with a Trap
Usl_53.Text: A container with an inert anti-rodent deterrent system with pressure action.

Usl_54.Name: Button
Usl_54.Text: A button belonging to Maria -- the great niece of the son of her double removed aunt. Handle with care.

Usl_55.Name: Matter Annihilator
Usl_55.Text: Matter annihilator, used by a human consul to dispose of secret documents.

Usl_57.Name: Penchesplasher Remains
Usl_57.Text: The remains of a penchesplasher -- an ancient Churassic ancestor of the modern day penchekrakus.

Usl_58.Name: Antique Carpet
Usl_58.Text: An antique carpet. Needs to be delivered to the dry-cleaner's.

Usl_59.Name: Shield Control Console
Usl_59.Text: A planetary shield control console, designed to keep dominators from landing on the planet's surface.

Usl_6.Name: Maloq Lie Detector
Usl_6.Text: An indispensable device for interrogating representatives of all races.

Usl_60.Name: Gaalian Book
Usl_60.Text: This gaalian book contains all the top-secret knowledge in the field of physics and high technologies.

Usl_62.Name: Geartrunk
Usl_62.Text: A new maloq invention in the field of high technology -- the geartrunk.

Usl_63.Name: Letter
Usl_63.Text: A most ordinary non-secret letter from one person to another, sealed in an ordinary paper envelope.

Usl_65.Name: Vessel of Moral Turpitude
Usl_65.Text: A Vessel of Moral Turpitude from the Galactic Museum of Vials and Containers.

Usl_66.Name: Black Box
Usl_66.Text: A black box with information about the final moments of an equantor dominator.

Usl_67.Name: Tape with Video Recording
Usl_67.Text: An ancient video recording about dominators.

Usl_68.Name: Vacuum extractor for small-scale life-forms
Usl_68.Text: A heavy-duty gaalian vacuum that is still economical and thrifty with respect to the items being sucked up. Retro style.

Usl_69.Name: MONSTER teleport
Usl_69.Text: A very odd-looking device created by faeyans for use as the standard method of instant translocation. Includes an integrated self-correction feature for failed teleportations

Usl_7.Name: Sports Mascot
Usl_7.Text: The stolen cut stone with a golden inscription "Strength and Honor."

Usl_70.Name: Data drive
Usl_70.Text: A high-capacity, but quite fragile data storage device. The receptacle for connecting to an information terminal is labeled "Do not insert the wrong side!"

Usl_71.Name: Secret Note with Password
Usl_71.Text: A small document with keywords list for a voice lock.

Usl_72.Name: Envelope Full of Credits
Usl_72.Text: Solid envelope, it can make someone a Richie Rich!

Usl_73.Name: Pirate Flag
Usl_73.Text: Famous "Jolly Rovher", once belonged to Bambai Frake.

Usl_75.Name: Capsule with Humanoid
Usl_75.Text: Cryocapsule, contains one of the Coalition's leaders. Has detonation anti-breaking system installed.

Usl_8.Name: Gift Box
Usl_8.Text: A colorful box with unknown contents.

Usl_9.Name: Bullfrog Incubator
Usl_9.Text: An efficient instrument for breeding ragobam bullfrogs.

Usl_AmuletFragment1.Name: Amulet Fragment
Usl_AmuletFragment1.Text: The first fragment of the Eye of the Crab amulet.

Usl_AmuletFragment2.Name: Amulet Fragment
Usl_AmuletFragment2.Text: The second fragment of the Eye of the Crab amulet.

Usl_AmuletFragment3.Name: Amulet Fragment
Usl_AmuletFragment3.Text: The third fragment of the Eye of the Crab amulet.

Usl_AncientCrystal.Name: Ancient holocrystal
Usl_AncientCrystal.Text: An ancient holocrystal which has lain on an empty planet since time began (maybe longer), which has been encoded with some incomprehensible cipher. Through a microscope you can see a half-erased marking that reads: "Property of Kuat Drive Yards". If you find this crystal, please return it to our employees without reading its contents. We recommend additional analysis by cryptographic specialists.

Usl_AnimalCase.Name: Cage with a Rare Animal
Usl_AnimalCase.Text: The cage holds a rare animal -- the rotmygut.

Usl_BeaconBox.Name: Container of beacons
Usl_BeaconBox.Text: A container of beacons designed to track pirate movements.

Usl_Blastshot.Name: Cryocapsule
Usl_Blastshot.Text: A cryocapsule with Blast Shot -- veteran of the anti-pirate movement.

Usl_Bomber.Name: White Ticket
Usl_Bomber.Text: A ticket allowing its bearer to viciously beat up their superior. Issued to pilots who are prepared to execute their orders at any cost.

Usl_Cactus.Name: Container with Cacti
Usl_Cactus.Text: Pots of cacti are visible through the transparent lid of the container.

Usl_CapsuleStukach.Name: Capsule
Usl_CapsuleStukach.Text: A life-saving capsule of a pirate snitch.

Usl_Citadels.Name: "Ci" Badge
Usl_Citadels.Text: Cast in the form of the Citadel intellectual game card. A collectible.

Usl_DataArchive.Name: Secret Archive
Usl_DataArchive.Text: A ruler's archive, containing encrypted information.

Usl_Drugs.Name: Report
Usl_Drugs.Text: A full report on the development of new weapons by Professor Koochie von Yuchee.

Usl_Elus.Name: Small Elunie
Usl_Elus.Text: A level 002 intellect diploma for Ranger <Player>. Grants the right to attend scientific council meetings.

Usl_Faruk.Name: Fariolas
Usl_Faruk.Text: Six foul-smelling fruits in an air-tight container.

Usl_Foncers.Name: Foncer-999
Usl_Foncers.Text: A champion's gold medal in foncer racing. Cast in the shape of a real-size racing bolide wheel.

Usl_Frodo.Name: Generator
Usl_Frodo.Text: A highly unusual power generator shaped like a ring.

Usl_GoldenRocket.Name: Gold Replica
Usl_GoldenRocket.Text: A collectible gold replica of the ancient human P-7 rocket.

Usl_InDrynCage.Name: Cage with Ein-Drein
Usl_InDrynCage.Text: A cage with a rare ten-gendered animal.

Usl_JimmyGuitar.Name: Guitar
Usl_JimmyGuitar.Text: An antique guitar once belonging to renowned rock musician Jimi Hendrigz.

Usl_LasosCup.Name: Cup
Usl_LasosCup.Text: A ceramic cup depicting some kind of fish.

Usl_Melok.Name: Crayon
Usl_Melok.Text: A Bin-Key crayon, designed to help fight the dominators.

Usl_Ministry.Name: Certificate
Usl_Ministry.Text: An official deed of ownership to the Rectal Island for the next 50 years.

Usl_MusicialTools.Name: Instruments
Usl_MusicialTools.Text: A container with percussion instruments from the hypermarket.

Usl_Muzon.Name: Musical Cup
Usl_Muzon.Text: A hyper-rock festival victor's cup. They say that if you put an ear to it, you can hear music from other worlds.

Usl_Orcs.Name: Ancient Book
Usl_Orcs.Text: A Tale of Filaneya and Gromgar -- the classic maloq military annal.

Usl_PTQ63.Name: Game Disk
Usl_PTQ63.Text: Disk with the newest game from the Space Rangers series.

Usl_PTQ64.Name: Promissory Note
Usl_PTQ64.Text: A payment order to receive a fee for completing a quest. Don't lose it!

Usl_PTQ65.Name: Evil Genius Monocle
Usl_PTQ65.Text: A bonus Evil Genius monocle. Issued as a memento of taking over the world.

Usl_PTQ66.Name: Great Fisher's Cup
Usl_PTQ66.Text: Great Fisher's Golden Cup for winning the fishing championship.

Usl_PTQ67.Name: Case with a Contract
Usl_PTQ67.Text: A case with a contract for qsetvoemitter production.

Usl_PTQ69.Name: Golden Palette Order
Usl_PTQ69.Text: A Golden Palette Order for winning the art tournament.

Usl_PTQ71.Name: Megavision Glasses
Usl_PTQ71.Text: Enable the bearer to see an experimental invisible ship.

Usl_Pilot.Name: License
Usl_Pilot.Text: A legal document, granting the bearer license to pilot heavy-load vessels.

Usl_RandomItem_01.Name: Container with an Animal
Usl_RandomItem_01.Text: Holds an unknown animal. Opening the container is NOT recommended!

Usl_RandomItem_02.Name: Urgent Letter
Usl_RandomItem_02.Text: A paper letter with additional orders. For the purpose of secrecy, it is made of paper and requires security.

Usl_RandomItem_03.Name: Armored Box with Precious Cargo
Usl_RandomItem_03.Text: A highly valuable cargo. So valuable that sawing the box in half is the only way of getting to it.

Usl_RandomItem_04.Name: Case with Documents
Usl_RandomItem_04.Text: A case with important documents that needs to be delivered to one of the planets.

Usl_Robots.Name: Dementor
Usl_Robots.Text: A giant Robot Battle Intergalactic Champion's Cup.

Usl_Rvk.Name: Military Uniform
Usl_Rvk.Text: Ceremonial military commander uniform. An inscription in gold letters reads "<Player>" on the chest.

Usl_Shashki.Name: Intellectual-PROF
Usl_Shashki.Text: An Intergalactic Hyperjumping Plasma Checkers Champion's Cup. A memorable prize cast out of the winner's checkers.

Usl_Soberisam.Name: Dominator Model Kit
Usl_Soberisam.Text: A construction set that makes it possible to assemble a miniature dominator model.

Usl_SpecialBomb.Name: Bomb
Usl_SpecialBomb.Text: A special bomb, manufactured to destroy research stations.

Usl_Stroyka.Name: Container with Construction Materials
Usl_Stroyka.Text: A universal kit for residential interior finish.

Usl_Svarokok.Name: Swarokox
Usl_Svarokok.Text: Traditional maloq medicine for treating blaster burns.

Usl_VigenereCoin.Name: Engraved coin
Usl_VigenereCoin.Text: Gold coin with encrypted engraving from captain Virsle. On the emblem of the pirate clan in capital letters it says "VIGENERE" in the middle, in small letters "kiiltgjtfjph kqxwzr" on the left and "virsle" on the right.
